AccountStatus.title: AccountStatus
AccountStatus.description: Public moderation status for pre-provisioned roster accounts managed by Admin.

suspended.description: Whether the account is suspended from submitting scores by Admin.

notes.description: Fair-play monitoring notes recorded by Admin.

updatedBy.description: Admin identifier that updated this status.

LeaderboardScore.title: LeaderboardScore
LeaderboardScore.description: A recorded game run on the global leaderboard.

username.description: The roster player who achieved the score.

score.description: Total final score (+10 per correct answer within 5s, -5 per wrong answer or timeout).

timeLimitSeconds.description: Game mode time limit in seconds (30s, 60s, or 120s).

timeoutCount.description: Total 5-second shot clock timeouts (-5 points each).

bestStreak.description: Longest consecutive correct answer streak during the run.

flagged.description: Whether the run has been flagged for fair-play review by Admin.

verified.description: Whether the run has been verified for fair play by Admin.

playedAtIso.description: ISO-8601 timestamp string when the run was completed.

/accountStatuses/{accountId}.description: Roster account status documents keyed by username (Carter, Ryker, Michael, Admin).

/leaderboardScores/{scoreId}.description: Global leaderboard scores across 30s, 60s, and 120s addition sprint modes.
